documents.summary: Ordinary match markets use regulation plus stoppage time. Extra time and shootouts require an explicit market exception.
The rules distinguish regulation-only markets from markets explicitly including overtime. Winner including overtime and Over/Under including overtime are separate named markets.
Ordinary markets default to regulation unless stated otherwise. Overtime-inclusive markets have a separate shootout scoring convention.

limitations: Nigeria rule documents were retrieved with Selenium; this verifies document access, not each observed quote's settlement scope
Listing labels such as 2 Way or Over/Under still require exact detail-market mapping
No independent price corroboration or calibrated model is implied
